_comment: Evaluation-framework defaults. Product behaviour lives in config.json; this file only shapes how tests/quality_runner.py and tests/quality_review.py are invoked. No credentials here — provider api_key/base_url still come from config.json. Precedence: explicit CLI flag > this file > the script's built-in default. Unknown keys are fatal. Point elsewhere with --quality-config or ISE_QUALITY_CONFIG. Changing the judge block after a review batch started is refused by the frozen review-manifest.

runner._comment: Defaults for `python -m tests.quality_runner`. Keys match the CLI flag names (--num-results -> num_results). null keeps the flag unset.

judge._comment: Defaults for `python -m tests.quality_review` (rubric v4). The resolved values plus this file's digest are frozen into review-manifest-v4.json on the first scored answer; editing them afterwards makes the reviewer refuse to run against that batch.
